description: This file implements access control logic for Twitch chat messages, including role-based restrictions, allowlist checks, and mention requirements. It defines functions to evaluate if a message should be allowed based on account configuration and message content.

methods.name: checkTwitchAccessControl
methods.description: Evaluates whether a Twitch chat message is allowed based on account settings, message content, and bot username.

methods.name: checkSenderRoles
methods.description: Checks if the message sender has any of the specified allowed roles.

methods.name: extractMentions
methods.description: Extracts and returns a list of mentioned usernames in a message.
